name: io.github.Fabsbags/starreview
title: StarReview
description: Drafts Google & TripAdvisor review replies; agents can never post themselves. Free rate check.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Required at this endpoint. Connect via OAuth (recommended, plug-and-play; discovered from the endpoint's .well-known/oauth-protected-resource) OR send an sragt_ bearer key as Authorization: Bearer sragt_.... Owner-created self-service keys are account-wide and use the multi-business picker; legacy/admin per-business credentials may pin one business. The free discovery tools (get_service_info, search_business, check_response_rate) need no credential but live at a separate URL: POST https://mcp.starreview.ch/public
